senses.gloss: (b. h.; Shaf. of זוּר)to twist.—Part. pass. שָׁזוּר; pl. שְׁזוּרִים, שְׁזוּרִין.
units: Y. Shek. VIII, 51ᵇ top (ref. to Ex. XXVI, 31) אילו נאמר חוט … שזור לשלשה מָשְׁזָר לששה וכ׳ if the text had ḥuṭ (thread), it would have meant one doubled to two, shazur would have meant triplex, moshzar means sixfold &c.
<cite ref="Eruvin 96b:11">Erub. 96ᵇ</cite> <he>בש׳</he> it means twisted threads (yarn, which is not used for weaving).
